name: Power of the Dragon
source:
You are a 19 years old guy living with your sister and your mother, you also have a twin brother who is in the army. Your father died when you wer 4 years old and your grandfather passed away 2 weeks ago. Your grandfather left behind a mysterious object - a ring which can make changes to your reality. The hero who disappeared 15 years ago will return.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/janeszi90]Patreon[/url]]
